audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart (phases[N].side) and the content-layer chart (win[N]) both read Skill/Olaf/Olaf/Skill/Skill/Olaf/Olaf, which contradicts the packet levelChart (Skill/Skill/Aatrox/Aatrox/Aatrox/Aatrox/Skill) AND the matchup's own whys[], which say the lane tilts to Aatrox from level 3 through two items.
audit.why: whys[2] 'From 3 his Q rotation and passive heal-on-hit start winning the extended trades', whys[3], whys[4], whys[5] all describe Aatrox-favoured stages while the chart marks them Olaf/Skill. Packet chart agrees with the prose, not the sides.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill, Skill, Aatrox, Aatrox, Aatrox, Aatrox, Skill in BOTH layers as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and whys[4] claim 'Ragnarok cannot out-heal a fully ulted Aatrox' — Ragnarok (R, 100/90/80s) grants armour/MR and immunity to disables while attacking; it has no healing at all. Olaf's sustain is Berserker Rage (P, lifesteal scaling with missing health) and Tough It Out (W, shield + attack speed).
audit.why: Riot's own text for Olaf R: 'passively gains increased armor and magic resist... immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.' No heal component.
audit.corrected: Restated as disable-immunity plus resists, not sustain; World Ender named as the healing/AD/Move Speed spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Abilities were referred to generically ('your committal tool', 'E true damage', 'W-omnivamp'). Olaf's W gives a shield and attack speed, not omnivamp. Real names absent from several phase whys.
audit.why: Undertow (Q, 9s, resets on axe pickup, armour shred + slow), Reckless Swing (E, 11/10/9/8/7s, true damage, self-damage refunded on kill), Tough It Out (W, 16/15/14/13/12s shield + attack speed), Ragnarok (R). Aatrox: The Darkin Blade (Q, 14/12/10/8/6s), Infernal Chains (W, 20/18/16/14/12s drag+slow), Umbral Dash (E, 9/8/7/6/5s dash + heal-on-damage), World Ender (R, 120/100/80s).
audit.corrected: Phase whys now name Undertow, Reckless Swing, Infernal Chains, Ragnarok and World Ender with their real cooldowns and effects.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why sold Sundered Sky as the forcing spike, but Aatrox's first drain-tank item is what flips that stage against you.
audit.why: Aatrox heals off Umbral Dash passive, Deathbringer Stance and World Ender; Grievous Wounds is the item that matters at that timing.
audit.corrected: Executioner's Calling prioritised at the first-item stage.

edits.before: E true damage on cooldown is free, armor-proof chip. Only take the trade when Aatrox's World Ender is down.
edits.after: Reckless Swing (E) is armour-proof chip every 11s, but Umbral Dash heals it back — hit and leave, never brawl.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Aatrox must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: From 3 his Q rotation and Deathbringer heal win the extended trade. Undertow slow, Reckless Swing, walk out before he stacks.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around World Ender's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Infernal Chains drags you back into his Q rotation and the drain stacks, so 4-5 is his. Hold the wave near your side and farm safe.

edits.before: Ragnarok deletes CC — once you press R, nothing he has stops the run-down. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Aatrox's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Ragnarok makes you immune to disables while you keep attacking, but it heals nothing — World Ender's drain outlasts your 100s ult. Fight it down.

edits.before: Sundered Sky is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on World Ender's cooldown.
edits.after: Executioner's Calling before Sundered Sky — his drain-tank item beats you in any long trade otherwise.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Aatrox carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Reckless Swing's true damage still bites his tanky build and your dive stays relevant — it evens back to a pick-trading skirmish.

edits.before: His R (World Ender) is his real spike — it heals him and pumps his combat stats, and your Ragnarok cannot out-heal a fully ulted Aatrox in a long fight.
edits.after: His R (World Ender) is his real spike — more healing, AD and Move Speed. Ragnarok gives resists and disable-immunity, not sustain, so it loses the long fight.

edits.before: His R (World Ender) heals and boosts combat stats — your Ragnarok cannot out-DPS a fully ulted Aatrox.
edits.after: World Ender boosts his healing, AD and speed — Ragnarok gives immunity to disables, not sustain.

notes: Aatrox's Infernal Chains (W) carries a derived 'grounding' flag that Riot's description does not support (drag to centre + slow only) — no grounding claim made here, matching the mirror audit. Olaf's W is Tough It Out (shield + attack speed); several page strings call it 'W-omnivamp', which is wrong — the sustain is Berserker Rage (P) missing-health lifesteal. Left those strings alone this pass where they sat inside long prose that would breach the length band; flagged for a later pass.
